speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The social needs of Singaporeans have become more complex as Singapore's demographics and economy change.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: This is augmented by the deep and far-reaching impact of COVID-19 on Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: More people need help, and lower income and vulnerable households are especially impacted.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) has responded with support during the Circuit Breaker.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will now refresh our strategies and policies, and step up our efforts to meet Singaporeans' needs, as we are still combating COVID-19 and the consequent economic impact.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The crisis will not divert us from our efforts to improve social mobility, and we will ensure that no Singaporean is left behind.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: All Singaporeans will have an important role to play as we strengthen our social compact.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will engage citizens, and work with community and corporate partners in the spirit of SG Together to co-create and codeliver social policies and programmes that can better serve Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will continue to review and strengthen our social safety nets.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We also provided ComCare recipients with longer periods of assistance.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: As we brace for a global economic downturn, we will continue to work with other agencies and community partners to strengthen social support for Singaporeans in need, including strengthening support for mental and family wellbeing.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will also dovetail our efforts with that of the National Jobs Council to facilitate the employment and training of Singaporeans, and assist those who still need help.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will enhance social service delivery, so that Singaporeans in need can receive comprehensive, convenient, and coordinated support.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: This has become especially important, as COVID-19 has exacerbated the challenges faced by vulnerable segments of our society who have less resources to buffer against the impact.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will expand our networks and programmes, such as the SG Cares Community Network and Community Link (ComLink), and deepen our collaboration with social service agencies (SSAs), community partners, and volunteers to proactively reach out to vulnerable Singaporeans and support the needs of each town.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Through partnerships such as the Partners Engaging and Empowering Rough Sleepers (PEERS) Network, the Vulnerable-in-the-Community Network, and the Food Workgroup, we will ensure that those in need receive timely help.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will systematically reach out to persons with disabilities and caregivers to better support them.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: In line with efforts by the National Jobs Council, we will sustain efforts to improve the employment and employability of persons with disabilities.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will also continue to support independent living for persons with disabilities, and maximise their potential at every stage of life.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We aim to provide better support for children with moderate to severe developmental needs within preschools.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: To give every child a good start in life, we will build on earlier efforts to enhance the accessibility, affordability, and quality of preschools.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: In the medium term, as Government-supported places increase, we will further lower their fee caps to enhance affordability.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Through the Growing Together with KidSTART initiative, we will deepen community partnerships to better support KidSTART families.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: To support youth-at-risk, offenders, and their families, we will adopt a more preventive approach, as well as better rehabilitative methods, and will work with agencies and partners through the National Committee on Prevention, Rehabilitation, and Recidivism to strengthen our programmes and capabilities.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Our youths must continue to have opportunities to succeed in life.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The family is the basic building block of our society.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will promote and support families through the Families for Life movement, bringing together like-minded individuals and organisations to build the support ecosystem.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Together with our community partners and volunteers, we will support couples and families on their marriage and parenthood journey, by providing evidence-based programmes and resources, and encouraging family-friendly practices, such as flexible work and workfrom-home arrangements, to help families manage their caregiving responsibilities.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will also strengthen preventive work with early-risk families, such as minor and young marriages and divorced families, and families with stresses through family counselling services, and early-risk marriage and divorce support, so as to reduce acrimony and improve outcomes for children and their families.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will work closely with other agencies and the community.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will continue to protect vulnerable individuals who are abused or neglected, and provide good alternative care for children and vulnerable adults whose families are unable to care for them.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The inter-agency Taskforce on Family Violence will consult widely with stakeholders, and further enhance measures to prevent and address family violence.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Our SSAs play a critical role in delivering social services to those who require help through COVID-19 and beyond.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will work in partnership with the NCSS-led Beyond COVID-19 Taskforce to drive the transformation of the social service sector to emerge stronger.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: COVID-19 has provided the added impetus for the social service sector to transform, so as to ensure service continuity and meet increased social needs.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Through the Social Service SkillsFuture Tripartite Taskforce, we will partner academia, professional associations, and SSAs to build the sector's manpower capability and competencies.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We are glad that there has been an outpouring of support for COVID-19-related causes.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will work with partners to sustain the spirit of philanthropy and volunteerism by encouraging Singaporeans to contribute through varied giving and volunteering opportunities in the community.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will also steward community resources prudently to benefit more Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: When the government and the people work together in solidarity, we will able to emerge stronger from this crisis.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: MSF will continue our mission to nurture resilient individuals, strong families, and a caring society.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will partner our agencies, our people, and the private sector, to build a stronger Singapore together.
